description: This file implements a cost calculation function for image generation models, specifically using Google's Vertex AI via the litellm library. It retrieves model info and computes costs based on the number of images in an ImageResponse.

classes.name: ImageResponse
classes.description: A data structure representing the response containing image data, imported from litellm.types.utils.

methods.name: float cost_calculator( model: str, image_response: Any, )
methods.description: Calculates the cost of image generation based on model info and the number of images in the response.
